Gideon Sato, I've posted the draft as a reply to your message in #strategic-random. I built it from #inc-vtg-hartford, which you're a member of. These are the three times:

- **First report:** 10:42 AM on Aug 3, 2026. Both inbound-lane gate kiosks at Vantorre's Hartford plant were offline.
- **Kiosk 1 back:** 11:03 AM. Mateo confirmed the guard checked in trailer 8836 and dispatch could see it.
- **Both lanes working:** 11:07 AM. You confirmed it in the channel at 11:08 AM.

The draft also notes that the status-page access issue is still open (INC-4821) and that appointment scheduling wasn't affected.

I haven't emailed it to anyone. Mateo is outside pemberline.com, so any mail to him needs Ruth Calloway's approval first.
